name: Ring of Confrontation, Greater
body:
Aura faint divination; CL 5th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

As the ring of confrontation, but the initial attitude is two steps lower than normal. Individuals who would have normally had the attitude of hostile or unfriendly will attack immediately and make the wearer the primary target of their attacks. An attacker will not put himself in harm’s way, such as passing through a threatened space, to do so.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove curse upon it, rendering it non-magical.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items diplomat’s ring, greater

Identification DC 30
False Identification DC 20
